target: 'Variant of the upcrossing estimate' module docstring in Mathlib/Probability/Martingale/Upcrossing.lean (lines 685-708)
claim: The PR edits this docstring ('left-hand side'), but its formulas misstate the code. (1) The measurability identity reads `U_N(a, b) = \sum_{i = 1}^N \mathbf{1}_{\{U_N(a, b) < N\}}`, which is circular. It then says $U_N(a,b)$ is measurable 'since $U_N(a, b)$ is a stopping time'. But `upcrossingsBefore_eq_sum` sums the indicators of `{n | upperCrossingTime a b f N n ω < N}`, i.e. of $\{\tau_i < N\}$, and the stopping time used is `upperCrossingTime` (`Adapted.isStoppingTime_upperCrossingTime`). (2) The target inequality is written with RHS `\sup_N \mathbb{E}[f_N]`, whereas `Submartingale.mul_lintegral_upcrossings_le_lintegral_pos_part` proves the bound by `⨆ N, ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal ((f N ω - a)⁺)`, i.e. $\sup_N \mathbb{E}[(f_N - a)^+]$.
requested_change: In this docstring, replace `\mathbf{1}_{\{U_N(a, b) < N\}}` with `\mathbf{1}_{\{\tau_i < N\}}`. Replace '$U_N(a, b)$ is measurable as $\{U_N(a, b) < N\}$ is a measurable set since $U_N(a, b)$ is a stopping time' with '$U_N(a, b)$ is measurable as $\{\tau_i < N\}$ is a measurable set since $\tau_i$ is a stopping time'. Change `\sup_N \mathbb{E}[f_N]` to `\sup_N \mathbb{E}[(f_N - a)^+]`.

The corrected docstring was checked with lean_verify_edit line mode 689-706: outcome compiled.
